status: post hoc and descriptive; criteria in criteria.json were written before computing; changes no preregistered decision

a_rho_by_format.inputs: SemEval binary F1 per checkpoint from results/revision/post8/e9.json tiers A (and C-auto as a sensitivity); within-drug AUROC per checkpoint from results/revision/amend7/e9.json e9.panel (tier A) and from post8/e9.json tier C-auto
a_rho_by_format.interval: percentile bootstrap over checkpoints within the stratum, 10000 draws, numpy RandomState(42); draws where either vector is constant are dropped and counted
a_rho_by_format.also: two-sided permutation p over 10000 random permutations of AUROC against F1, RandomState(43)
a_rho_by_format.caveat_to_state: n = 10 per format; the AUROC values carry their own two-way bootstrap uncertainty (within-checkpoint SD about 0.03) which the checkpoint bootstrap ignores

b_partner_adjusted.systems: b2mixed BiomedBERT (seed mean of seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4, ood_empty / oodold_empty), the 20 Amendment 7 panel checkpoints (runs/preds a7-panel-*, variants marker and pair, ood_empty / oodold_empty, one seed each), Qwen2.5-7B names only (llm-qwen-names), DrugBank lookup
b_partner_adjusted.cohorts: Novel (438 rows, 48 drugs) and Older-clean (1832 rows, 128 drugs), tier A
b_partner_adjusted.scale: logit of P(interaction) for models, the 0/1 listing for DrugBank, as in experiment 7
b_partner_adjusted.partner_prior: label-free: baselines.Context.partner_prior, the share of vocabulary Drug Interactions sections (excluding the partner's own RxCUI) that name the partner; feature iii2 of scripts/amend7_cpu_exp7_below_chance.py
b_partner_adjusted.adjustment: within-drug residualization of experiment 7 (partial): demean score and prior within OOD drug, regress, subtract slope times prior from the score; adjusted within-drug AUROC on the residual
b_partner_adjusted.intervals: two-way cluster bootstrap over OOD drugs and partner drugs, amend7_cpu_common.paired_draws, 1000 draws, seed 1042 Novel and 42 Older-clean, raw and adjusted in the same draws; the paired difference adjusted minus raw is reported
b_partner_adjusted.tetrad: doubly matched tetrad AUROC of post7_common.tetrad_design on the additive scale, two-way weights of post7_common.scheme_weights with the same seeds; values for systems already in results/revision/post7/partner.json are checked against that file
b_partner_adjusted.reproduction_checks: b2mixed, Qwen and DrugBank adjusted values must equal experiment 7 iii2 partialled values to 3 decimals; tetrad values must equal post7/partner.json
